Theorem
[Weinberger--Hamilton maximum principle for systems] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0200 1. ch12:12.34\group Weak System Maximum Principles

Let $\mathcal K\subset \mathcal V$ be closed, invariant under parallel translation, and fiberwise convex. Suppose $F(u,t)$ is continuous and locally Lipschitz in $u$, and every solution of $U'=F_x(U,t)$ starting in $\mathcal K_x$ remains there. If \[ u_t=\Delta u+\nabla _{X(t)}u+F(u,t),qquad d(u(x,t),\mathcal K_x)\leq e^{\widehat a(d_{g(t)}(O,x)+1)}, \] and $u(x,0)\in \mathcal K_x$, then $u(x,t)\in \mathcal K_x$ for all $x,t$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:time-dependent-convex-set-maximum-principle Take the constant family $\mathcal K(t)=\mathcal K$ in Theorem 3.1.
